name: Kouzuka Michi
source: Daichi's older sister and a graduate of Ainoshima Academy. She is also the one that reformed Daichi from being a recluse and recommended him to transfer to Ainoshima Academy. She may look gaudy and loose but is actually a domestic and caring person. The people around her still call her by her nickname "Slut."
